turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so you have twenty minutes. Owen found out about that zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided, and on what basis?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
"What we found." Who is "we," Hale, and was Owen heard before that zero went in?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.

A file created at 11:31 PM is a file created at 11:31 PM, not proof of who wrote the essay or when he started it. Owen told me he wrote it over the weekend. Show me that history yourself, and you still haven't answered me: was Owen heard before that zero went in?
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.

I'm writing down 11:52, 612, 11:58, 794. "Mostly in one paste" from where, Hale, because people paste from their own notes every day, and I want to read that history on the screen myself, with the date on it. And I've now asked you twice whether Owen was heard before the zero went in.
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Don't manage me, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.

Which three editions, Hale, because a seventeen-year-old misquoting Shakespeare at midnight is a student who misquoted Shakespeare, nothing more. I'm writing that line down, and I'll check it myself tonight. You've now dodged my question about whether Owen was heard four times, and I've noticed.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
Then why are we here, Hale? Stop complimenting me and show me that document history on the screen, with the date on it.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.

Students change their minds between an outline and a final draft, Hale; that's what an outline is for. I'm writing down October 15, and I want that outline and the document history in front of me, not described to me. What else do you have?
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.

There it is: a machine's guess. Turnitin's own guide says the AI indicator "should not be used as the sole basis for adverse actions against a student," and I have it printed in my bag, along with your own procedure 4.3. If that 94 is what put a zero in the gradebook before anyone called me, we're done here and I'm going upstairs.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
There's no off the record in this room, Hale, and you're asking me how to do your job? Take the zero out of the gradebook, follow your own procedure, and put Owen's apology in writing.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.

Ten minutes. You're offering a rewrite for an essay you still haven't shown me a single page of, and before we talk about any rewrite, that zero comes out of the gradebook. Turn the screen and show me the history and the outline, Hale.
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? We're here about Owen, not about me. Turn the screen, Hale.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.

"Monday." I'm going to the principal today, Hale, with your procedure 4.2 and 4.3 highlighted, because nobody called me before that zero went in. I didn't refuse anything; I asked to see the documents, and you still haven't turned the screen.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither. The zero comes off first, then you show me the documents, and then we talk.
